If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% for late horizon (16–30 days).

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for early horizon to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon to avoid overcorrection.

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, cap forecast at +2.0% above historical 30d mean for late horizon to avoid overbought bias.
